title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisons of G.L. c. 164, Sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1881, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 687, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of May, June, and July 1986. The fuel charge reflects changes in the prudently incurred, rasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
